description: Non-ARQ U_PDUs count against their client until the transmission carrying their last D_PDU ends: a client held off by S_DATA_FLOW_OFF is sent S_DATA_FLOW_ON at that transmit_done, once its count is down to four MTUs.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and sends eight 2048-byte U_PDUs to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 (bytes i, i+1, ... mod 256 for the i-th, TTL 0, TTD 1296000000 ms). The first starts dts.ttd and the MAC's first LBT wait; the eighth brings conn 1 to eight MTUs, so S_DATA_FLOW_OFF follows its acceptance (interp S-0163). The fixture block holds 20480 bytes, so one block carries everything, and csma.num_cont_slots 1 gives a zero contention wait (K-0080): at 30000 one transmission carries all eight C_PDUs, each a 2054-byte DATA C_PDU (the 2048-byte U_PDU, the 5-byte DATA S_PDU header with its TTD, and the C_PCI byte) cut by dts.max_segment_size 1023 into 1023, 1023 and 8 bytes (C-0525 to C-0529), C_PDU IDs 0 to 7 (C-0326, C-1040), every D_PDU type 7, address size 3, in block 0 of a 5550 ms burst, EOT and window 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). Under interp C-1255 the DTS confirms each non-ARQ request when the transmission carrying its last D_PDU ends, in placement order, and the CAS passes each confirmation up; each ends that U_PDU's count, and after the fourth conn 1 is at four MTUs and gets S_DATA_FLOW_ON (S-0021; interp S-0163) at transmit_done. The queue is then empty, so the MAC does nothing more.
